note: [L] needs the probe clearance `Fits M φ w x A` as a hypothesis and states the bound along a filter with a fixed rate sequence.

lemma Funds.outputs (h : Funds Z M φ T A s c e) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hv : s ≤ 1) (hp : Fits M φ w x A) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.row (x i) w (e i)) (c-w*s):= by
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with h'|hs
  · subst s; simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] using Against.row M hT e (h.tests hT H le_rfl le_rfl hv) le_rfl le_rfl hp h.loose -- dot order inspect
  obtain ⟨g,hh,hq⟩:= (Matchable.layer hT H ha hs le_rfl hv hx h).replaces (c-w*s-probeFee M w)
  have hw:= Against.row M hT (e-g) hq le_rfl zero_le_one hp (loose_diff h.loose ((hh.fine hT hx).increase_layer hv))
  rw [mul_one,sub_add_cancel] at hw
  refine (hw.add (hh.row hT hs.le w) hT).congr ?_
  filter_upwards with i; simp

proof_context.conclusion: For a `Funds` expression of cost `c` at height `s`, the degree-`w` contact row has rate at most `c - w*s` where `Fits` gives probe clearance; the case `s = 0` tests the fixed probes directly.

lemma row (h : Override Z M φ T x s c e)(hs : 0 ≤ s) (w : ℕ) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.row (x i) w (e i)) (c - w*s) := by
   induction h with
   | @atom d f h =>
     by_cases he:w ≤ d
     · simp_rw [M.row_of_field]; exact (rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.part w d)) hT h).mono (by gcongr)
     simp_rw [M.row_of_field, M.splitting.beyondZero (show d<w from not_le.mp he), LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact RateLE.zero φ T (X:=S.Field w) _
   | zero => simp only [Pi.zero_apply,map_zero]; exact RateLE.zero φ T (X:=S.Field w) _
   | plus _ _ hx hy=> simp_rw [Pi.add_apply,map_add]; exact hx.add hy hT
   | germ _ h hx=> exact hx.congr (h.mono fun i hi=> congr_arg (M.row (x i) w) hi)

proof_context.conclusion: On a degree-`d` field the row is zero for `d < w` and has rate `c - d*s <= c - w*s` otherwise.

lemma Against.row {w : ℕ} (e : W→ Expression Z.sector.derivatives)
    (h : Against Z M φ T A s v c e) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hc : Fits M φ w x A) (hE : ∃ u, Fine M φ T A 1 u e) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.row (x i) w (e i)) (c+probeFee M w*v) := by
   let θ := M.tests w; let k:=c+probeFee M w*v; let y (b:Bool) (i:W) (s:Ortho):= θ.decode (fun j=> if b then star (M.survey s j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey s j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i)))
   have hm (b : Bool) (σ : W→Ortho) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.rotation.act w (σ i) (y b i (σ i))) k := by
      apply act_any (M:=M) hT _; apply rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.tests w).decode) hT (f:=fun i j=> if b then star (M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))); intro v hv'
      let f' i (j:(M.tests w).probes):=if b then star (M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))
      have he(j:(M.tests w).probes):RateLE φ T (fun i=>f' i j) k:= by unfold f'; cases b; exact survey_rate M hT j h hc hs hv false σ; exact fn_star (survey_rate M hT j h hc hs hv true σ)
      filter_upwards [eventually_all.mpr fun j=> he j v hv'] with i hi using (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg (v*T i)) (x:=f' i)).mpr hi
   have he(b : Bool):= fn_integral (f:=fun s i=> M.rotation.act w s (y b i s)) (hm b); let f:=M.hierarchy.spin
   let g(i:W):= M.base w (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))
   apply rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.top w)) hT (f:=g); refine RateLE.congr ((((RateLE.const ((2:ℂ)⁻¹) hT).smul ((he false).add (fn_real (M:=M) hT (he true)) hT)).mono (le_of_eq (zero_add k)))) ?_
   filter_upwards [hE.choose_spec.fit_shift hc le_rfl] with i hi using (M.base_survey w hi).symm

proof_context.conclusion: A row is bounded by averaging the probe surveys over `O(4)`, at the cost `probeFee` raised by the precision.
